Require Export Arith.EqNat.

From Stdlib Require Export PeanoNat.

Require Export stlc1.

Inductive wf_env : venv -> tenv -> Prop :=
| wfe_nil : forall n, wf_env (@Def vl nil nil n) (@Def ty nil nil n)
| wfe_cons : forall v t vs ts n,
    val_type (expand_env vs v n) v t ->
    wf_env vs ts ->
    get_inv_idx vs = get_inv_idx ts ->
    wf_env (expand_env vs v n) (expand_env ts t n)

with val_type : venv -> vl -> ty -> Prop :=
| v_bool: forall venv b,
    val_type venv (vbool b) TBool
| v_abs: forall env venv tenv y T1 T2 m retcl,
    wf_env venv tenv ->
    has_type (expand_env (expand_env tenv (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) Second) T1 m) y retcl T2 ->
    val_type env (vabs venv m y retcl) (TFun T1 m T2 retcl).

Inductive stp: venv -> ty -> venv -> ty -> Prop :=
| stp_refl: forall G1 G2 T,
   stp G1 T G2 T.

Inductive res_type: venv -> option vl -> ty -> Prop :=
| not_stuck: forall venv v T,
      val_type venv v T ->
      res_type venv (Some v) T.

Theorem full_safety : forall k e n tenv venv res T,
  teval k venv e n = Some res -> has_type tenv e n T -> wf_env venv tenv ->
  res_type venv res T.

Require Export Arith.EqNat.

Require Export Arith.

Require Export List.

Require Export Lia.

Export ListNotations.

Definition id := nat.

Inductive class : Type :=
  | First  : class
  | Second : class
.

Definition subcl (n m : class) :=
  match n, m with
  | First, Second => true
  | Second, First => false
  | _, _ => true
  end.

Inductive ty : Type :=
  | TBool  : ty
  | TFun   : ty -> class -> ty -> class -> ty
.

Inductive var : Type :=
  | V : class -> id -> var
.

Inductive tm : Type :=
  | ttrue  : tm
  | tfalse : tm
  | tvar   : var -> tm
  | tapp   : tm -> tm -> tm
  | tabs   : class -> tm -> class -> tm
.

Inductive env {X: Type} :=
  | Def (fc : list X) (sc : list X) (sc_min : nat).

Inductive vl : Type :=
  | vbool : bool -> vl
  | vabs  : @env vl -> class -> tm -> class -> vl
.

Definition venv := @env vl.

Definition tenv := @env ty.

Fixpoint index {X : Type} (n : id) (l : list X) : option X :=
  match l with
    | [] => None
    | a :: l'  => if Nat.eqb n (length l') then Some a else index n l'
  end.

Definition lookup {X : Type} (n : var) (l : @env X) : option X :=
  match l with
    | Def l1 l2 m =>
         match n with
           | V First idx  => index idx l1
           | V Second idx => if m <=? idx then index idx l2 else None
         end
   end
.

Section env_tests.

Let t1_1 := TBool.

Let t1_0 := TFun TBool First TBool First.

Let t2_0 := TBool.

Let t2_1 := TFun TBool First TBool Second.

Let t2_2 := TBool.

Let t2_3 := TFun TBool Second TBool Second.

Let sc_min := 1.

Let example_env := Def [t1_1; t1_0] [t2_3; t2_2; t2_1; t2_0] sc_min.

End env_tests.

Definition sanitize_any {X : Type} (l : @env X) (n:nat): @env X :=
  match l with
    | Def l1 l2 _ => Def l1 l2 n
  end.

Definition sanitize_env {X : Type} (c : class) (l : @env X) : @env X :=
  match c,l  with
    | First, Def _ l2 _ => sanitize_any l (length l2)
    | Second, _ => l
  end.

Definition expand_env {X : Type} (l : @env X) (x : X) (c : class) : (@env X) :=
match l with
| Def l1 l2 m =>
   match c with
   | First => @Def X (x::l1) l2 m
   | Second => @Def X l1 (x::l2) m
   end
end
.

Inductive has_type : tenv -> tm -> class -> ty -> Prop :=
| t_true: forall n env,
           has_type env ttrue n TBool
| t_false: forall n env,
           has_type env tfalse n TBool
| t_var: forall n x env T1,
           lookup x (sanitize_env n env) = Some T1 ->
           has_type env (tvar x) n T1
| t_app: forall m retcl q env f x T1 T2,
           has_type env f Second (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) ->
           has_type env x m T1 ->
           subcl retcl q = true ->
           has_type env (tapp f x) q T2
 | t_abs: forall m n retcl env y T1 T2,
           has_type (expand_env (expand_env (sanitize_env n env) (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) Second) T1 m) y retcl T2 ->
           has_type env (tabs m y retcl) n (TFun T1 m T2 retcl).

Definition get_inv_idx {X : Type} (env : @env X) :=
match env with
| Def l1 l2 idx => idx
end
.

Section has_type_tests.

Let identity_ff := (tabs First (tvar (V First 0)) First).

Let app_id_true := (tapp identity_ff ttrue).

End has_type_tests.

Fixpoint teval(k: nat)(env: venv)(t: tm)(n: class){struct k}: option (option vl) :=
  match k with
    | 0 => None
    | S k' =>
      match t with
      | ttrue      => Some (Some (vbool true))
      | tfalse     => Some (Some (vbool false))
      | tvar x     => Some (lookup x (sanitize_env n env))
      | tabs m y retcl => Some (Some (vabs (sanitize_env n env) m y retcl))
      | tapp ef ex   =>
         match teval k' env ef Second, n with
           | None, _ => None
           | Some None, _ => Some None
           | Some (Some (vbool _)), _ => Some None
           | Some (Some (vabs env2 m ey Second)), First => Some None
           | Some (Some (vabs env2 m ey retcl)), _ =>
              match teval k' env ex m with
                | None => None
                | Some None => Some None
                | Some (Some vx) =>
                teval k' (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey retcl) Second) vx m) ey retcl
              end
          end
      end
  end.

Section teval_tests.

Let mt : @env vl := (Def [] [] 0).

Let c1 := (tapp (tabs First (tvar (V First 0)) First) ttrue).

Let c3 := (tapp (tabs Second (tvar (V Second 1)) Second) ttrue).

Let c4 :=
    (tapp
      (tapp
        (tabs Second (tabs First (tvar (V Second 1)) Second) Second)
        ttrue)
      tfalse).

Let c5 :=
    (tapp
      (tapp
        (tabs Second (tabs First (tvar (V First 0)) Second) Second)
        ttrue)
      tfalse).

Let c6 :=
    (tapp
      (tapp
        (tabs Second (tabs Second (tvar (V Second 3)) Second) Second)
        ttrue)
      tfalse).

End teval_tests.

Definition length_env {X : Type} (c : class) (env : @env X): nat :=
match env, c with
| Def l1 l2 n, First => length l1
| Def l1 l2 n, Second => length l2
end
.

Definition get_class (x : var): class :=
match x with
| V c _ => c
end
.

Definition get_idx (x : var): nat :=
match x with
| V _ n => n
end
.

content.thinking:
Let me think about this. We need to prove `full_safety`.

Definitions:
- `teval k env t n` returns `option (option vl)`.
- `has_type tenv e n T`.
- `wf_env venv tenv`.
- Conclude `res_type venv res T` where `res = Some v` (since res_type only has `Some v` constructor... actually res_type takes `option vl`, but only constructor is not_stuck for `Some v`). So we need to show res must be Some v.

Wait, but teval can return `Some None`. In that case res_type venv (Some None) T would need... res_type is `venv -> option vl -> ty -> Prop`. The constructor not_stuck gives res_type venv (Some v) T for v : vl. Here the argument `res` is `option vl`. So `res_type venv (Some None)` would require `Some None` to be `Some v` with v : vl, but None is not a vl. So indeed if teval returns `Some None`, safety would fail... unless the statement is actually that the result can't be None under the hypotheses.

Hmm, but the statement says: teval k venv e n = Some res -> ... -> res_type venv res T. If res = None (i.e., teval returns Some None), that's a contradiction with the hypotheses? Wait teval returns `Some None` in several cases: when ef evaluates to Non-value, or bvool applied, etc. Under well-typedness, those cases presumably cannot happen. So full_safety also includes the "doesn't get stuck" property: the evaluator never returns Some None on well-typed terms.

This is the standard logical relations / step-indexed soundness proof from the "second-class values" paper (POPL?). Let me recall: this is from the paper "Second-Class Values" ... Actually this looks like a TAPL-style interpreter with classes First/Second, from the course/some development. Let me search for the source—but we can't search the web. We must prove it ourselves.

Let me understand the semantics and typing.

Types: TBool, TFun T1 m T2 retcl. Functions have argument class m and return class retcl.

Environment: Def fc sc sc_min. First-class section fc (list), second-class sc (list), and sc_min threshold.

lookup (V First idx) = index idx fc.
lookup (V Second idx) = if m <=? idx then index idx sc else None, where m = sc_min.

sanitize_env First env = sanitize_any env (length sc) — sets sc_min to length of second-class list. sanitize_env Second env = env.

sanitize_any (Def l1 l2 _) n = Def l1 l2 n.

expand_env l x First = Def (x::l1) l2 m; expand_env l x Second = Def l1 (x::l2) m.

has_type:
- t_true/t_false : has_type env ttrue n TBool (any class n).
- t_var: lookup x (sanitize_env n env) = Some T1 -> has_type env (tvar x) n T1.
- t_app: has_type env f Second (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) -> has_type env x m T1 -> subcl retcl q = true -> has_type env (tapp f x) q T2.
- t_abs: has_type (expand_env (expand_env (sanitize_env n env) (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) Second) T1 m) y retcl T2 -> has_type env (tabs m y retcl) n (TFun T1 m T2 retcl).

Interesting: at abstraction, the body is type-checked in an environment extended with the function type in the second-class section (regardless of n) and the argument type at class m (argument class). And returns body at class retcl.

Hmm, and the whole function has class n (the class where the abstraction appears), but class of function is not constrained by m/retcl. Interesting.

val_type:
- v_bool venv b : val_type venv (vbool b) TBool.
- v_abs: wf_env venv tenv -> has_type (expand_env (expand_env tenv (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) Second) T1 m) y retcl T2 -> val_type env (vabs venv m y retcl) (TFun T1 m T2 retcl).

Note val_type takes an extra `env` venv which is unused in v_abs (val_type env ...). Actually `env` is a parameter of val_type; v_abs ignores it. And v_bool ignores it too. So val_type is a relation between vl, ty indirectly; env is irrelevant. Anyway.

wf_env:
- wfe_nil : wf_env (Def [] [] n) (Def [] [] n) for any n. Note same n in both.
- wfe_cons: val_type (expand_env vs v n) v t -> wf_env vs ts -> get_inv_idx vs = get_inv_idx ts -> wf_env (expand_env vs v n) (expand_env ts t n).

So wf_env relates venv, tenv element-wise, by val_type. Note expand uses same class n and same value/type.

Hmm the wfe_nil requires get_inv_idx the same n. And wfe_cons preserves.

Key: `wf_env venv tenv` should imply `get_inv_idx venv = get_inv_idx tenv` and that entries lookup correspond.

Goal: full_safety.

Let me think about the proof strategy. Standard: define logical relation `val_type` is already a "semantic type" but with has_type inside. Actually val_type is defined mutually with wf_env and refers to has_type. We might need to define an "expression relation" `exp_type` or similar, and prove a fundamental lemma for has_type: if has_type tenv e n T and wf_env venv tenv then for all k, teval k venv e n is not None (i.e., is Some), and if it's Some (Some v) then val_type venv v T; specifically teval terminates and returns Some (Some v) with val_type.

Wait but teval gives `option (option vl)`. For well-typed e, we want teval k venv e n = Some (Some v) with val_type venv v T? Is that true for arbitrary k? No—k is fuel. Require Export Arith.EqNat.

From Stdlib Require Export PeanoNat.

Require Export stlc1.

Inductive wf_env : venv -> tenv -> Prop :=
| wfe_nil : forall n, wf_env (@Def vl nil nil n) (@Def ty nil nil n)
| wfe_cons : forall v t vs ts n,
    val_type (expand_env vs v n) v t ->
    wf_env vs ts ->
    get_inv_idx vs = get_inv_idx ts ->
    wf_env (expand_env vs v n) (expand_env ts t n)

with val_type : venv -> vl -> ty -> Prop :=
| v_bool: forall venv b,
    val_type venv (vbool b) TBool
| v_abs: forall env venv tenv y T1 T2 m retcl,
    wf_env venv tenv ->
    has_type (expand_env (expand_env tenv (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) Second) T1 m) y retcl T2 ->
    val_type env (vabs venv m y retcl) (TFun T1 m T2 retcl).

Inductive stp: venv -> ty -> venv -> ty -> Prop :=
| stp_refl: forall G1 G2 T,
   stp G1 T G2 T.

Inductive res_type: venv -> option vl -> ty -> Prop :=
| not_stuck: forall venv v T,
      val_type venv v T ->
      res_type venv (Some v) T.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Auxiliary machinery                                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Mutual induction principle for the wf_env / val_type block.  Coq does
   not generate the individual schemes automatically because the two
   types are defined mutually. *)
Scheme wf_env_mut_ind := Induction for wf_env Sort Prop
  with val_type_mut_ind := Induction for val_type Sort Prop.

(* Accessors for the two components of an environment. *)
Definition fc {X : Type} (e : @env X) : list X :=
  match e with Def l _ _ => l end.

Definition sc {X : Type} (e : @env X) : list X :=
  match e with Def _ l _ => l end.

Lemma fc_expand_first : forall {X} (e : @env X) x,
  fc (expand_env e x First) = x :: fc e.
Proof. intros X e x. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fc_expand_second : forall {X} (e : @env X) x,
  fc (expand_env e x Second) = fc e.
Proof. intros X e x. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sc_expand_first : forall {X} (e : @env X) x,
  sc (expand_env e x First) = sc e.
Proof. intros X e x. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sc_expand_second : forall {X} (e : @env X) x,
  sc (expand_env e x Second) = x :: sc e.
Proof. intros X e x. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. reflexivity. Qed.

(* val_type does not actually depend on its first (venv) argument. *)
Lemma val_type_irrel : forall a b v t, val_type a v t -> val_type b v t.
Proof.
  intros a b v t H. inversion H; subst.
  - constructor.
  - econstructor; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma sanitize_any_expand : forall {X} (e : @env X) x n k,
  sanitize_any (expand_env e x n) k = expand_env (sanitize_any e k) x n.
Proof.
  intros X e x n k. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. destruct n; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Changing the sc_min index simultaneously in both environments
   preserves well-formedness. *)
Lemma wf_env_sanitize_any : forall vs ts, wf_env vs ts ->
  forall k, wf_env (sanitize_any vs k) (sanitize_any ts k).
Proof.
  intros vs ts H.
  refine (wf_env_mut_ind
            (fun vs ts _ => forall k, wf_env (sanitize_any vs k) (sanitize_any ts k))
            (fun _ _ _ _ => True) _ _ _ _ vs ts H).
  - intros n k. simpl. constructor.
  - intros v t vs0 ts0 n Hv IHv Hw IHw He k.
    rewrite sanitize_any_expand. rewrite sanitize_any_expand.
    econstructor.
    + apply val_type_irrel. exact Hv.
    + apply IHw.
    + destruct (sanitize_any vs0 k) as [a b c];
      destruct (sanitize_any ts0 k) as [d e f]; reflexivity.
  - intros. exact I.
  - intros. exact I.
Qed.

(* Indexed structural description of a list of values paired with a list
   of types. *)
Fixpoint lc (vs : list vl) (ts : list ty) : Prop :=
  match vs, ts with
  | [], [] => True
  | v :: vs', t :: ts' => val_type (@Def vl [] [] 0) v t /\ lc vs' ts'
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Lemma lc_length : forall vs ts, lc vs ts -> length vs = length ts.
Proof.
  intros vs. induction vs as [|v vs' IH]; intros ts H.
  - destruct ts; simpl in *; [reflexivity | contradiction].
  - destruct ts as [|t ts']; simpl in *; [contradiction |].
    destruct H as [Hv Htl]. simpl. f_equal. apply IH, Htl.
Qed.

Lemma index_Some_lt : forall {X} (l : list X) i a,
  index i l = Some a -> i < length l.
Proof.
  intros X l. induction l as [|a l' IH]; intros i b Hi; simpl in Hi.
  - discriminate.
  - destruct (Nat.eqb i (length l')) eqn:E.
    + apply Nat.eqb_eq in E. lia.
    + apply IH in Hi. simpl. lia.
Qed.

Lemma index_exists : forall {X} (l : list X) i,
  i < length l -> exists a, index i l = Some a.
Proof.
  intros X l. induction l as [|a l' IH]; intros i Hi.
  - simpl in Hi. lia.
  - simpl. destruct (Nat.eqb i (length l')) eqn:E.
    + exists a. reflexivity.
    + apply IH. apply Nat.eqb_neq in E. simpl in Hi. lia.
Qed.

Lemma lc_index : forall vs ts, lc vs ts ->
  forall i v, index i vs = Some v ->
    exists t, index i ts = Some t /\ val_type (@Def vl [] [] 0) v t.
Proof.
  intros vs. induction vs as [|v' vs' IH]; intros ts Hlc i v Hi.
  - destruct ts; simpl in *; [discriminate | contradiction].
  - destruct ts as [|t' ts']; simpl in *; [contradiction |].
    destruct Hlc as [Hv Htl].
    destruct (Nat.eqb i (length vs')) eqn:E.
    + injection Hi as Hveq. subst v.
      assert (Hlen : length vs' = length ts') by (apply lc_length, Htl).
      assert (E' : (i =? length ts') = true)
        by (apply Nat.eqb_eq; apply Nat.eqb_eq in E; lia).
      exists t'. simpl. rewrite E'. split; [reflexivity | exact Hv].
    + eapply IH; [exact Htl | exact Hi].
Qed.

Lemma lc_index_inv : forall vs ts, lc vs ts ->
  forall i t, index i ts = Some t ->
    exists v, index i vs = Some v /\ val_type (@Def vl [] [] 0) v t.
Proof.
  intros vs ts Hlc i t Hi.
  assert (Hlen : length vs = length ts) by (apply lc_length, Hlc).
  assert (Hlt : i < length vs) by (rewrite Hlen; apply index_Some_lt, Hi).
  destruct (index_exists vs i Hlt) as [v Hv].
  destruct (lc_index vs ts Hlc i v Hv) as [t' [Ht' Hvt]].
  rewrite Hi in Ht'. injection Ht' as Heq. subst t'.
  exists v. split; [exact Hv | exact Hvt].
Qed.

(* Structural facts about well-formed environments. *)
Definition wf_facts (vs : venv) (ts : tenv) : Prop :=
  length (fc vs) = length (fc ts) /\
  length (sc vs) = length (sc ts) /\
  get_inv_idx vs = get_inv_idx ts /\
  lc (fc vs) (fc ts) /\
  lc (sc vs) (sc ts).

Lemma wf_env_facts : forall vs ts, wf_env vs ts -> wf_facts vs ts.
Proof.
  intros vs ts H.
  refine (wf_env_mut_ind
            (fun vs ts _ => wf_facts vs ts)
            (fun _ _ _ _ => True) _ _ _ _ vs ts H).
  - intros n. unfold wf_facts. simpl. repeat split; auto.
  - intros v t vs0 ts0 n Hv IHv Hw IHw He.
    unfold wf_facts in *.
    destruct IHw as (L1 & L2 & EI & C1 & C2).
    destruct vs0 as [vs1 vs2 vm]; destruct ts0 as [ts1 ts2 tm];
      destruct n; simpl in *.
    + repeat split.
      * simpl. f_equal. exact L1.
      * exact L2.
      * exact EI.
      * simpl. split; [ apply val_type_irrel; exact Hv | exact C1 ].
      * exact C2.
    + repeat split.
      * exact L1.
      * simpl. f_equal. exact L2.
      * exact EI.
      * exact C1.
      * simpl. split; [ apply val_type_irrel; exact Hv | exact C2 ].
  - intros. exact I.
  - intros. exact I.
Qed.

(* Sanitizing by a class preserves well-formedness. *)
Lemma wf_env_sanitize_env : forall c venv tenv,
  wf_env venv tenv -> wf_env (sanitize_env c venv) (sanitize_env c tenv).
Proof.
  intros c venv tenv H. destruct c.
  - destruct venv as [vs1 vs2 vm]; destruct tenv as [ts1 ts2 tm].
    pose proof (wf_env_facts _ _ H) as F.
    destruct F as (L1 & L2 & EI & C1 & C2).
    simpl. rewrite <- L2.
    apply wf_env_sanitize_any. exact H.
  - exact H.
Qed.

(* Lookup correspondence between the two sides of a well-formed
   environment. *)
Lemma lookup_wf : forall venv tenv, wf_env venv tenv ->
  forall c x T, lookup x (sanitize_env c tenv) = Some T ->
    exists v, lookup x (sanitize_env c venv) = Some v /\ val_type venv v T.
Proof.
  intros venv tenv Hwf c x T Hlk.
  pose proof (wf_env_facts _ _ Hwf) as F.
  destruct F as (L1 & L2 & EI & C1 & C2).
  destruct venv as [vs1 vs2 vm]; destruct tenv as [ts1 ts2 tm].
  destruct x as [cl i]; destruct c; destruct cl; simpl in *.
  - (* sanitize First, V First *)
    destruct (lc_index_inv vs1 ts1 C1 i T Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
    exists v. split; [exact Hv | apply val_type_irrel; exact Hvt].
  - (* sanitize First, V Second *)
    destruct (Nat.leb (length ts2) i) eqn:E; [| discriminate].
    destruct (lc_index_inv vs2 ts2 C2 i T Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
    exists v. split.
    + rewrite L2. rewrite E. simpl. exact Hv.
    + apply val_type_irrel; exact Hvt.
  - (* sanitize Second, V First *)
    destruct (lc_index_inv vs1 ts1 C1 i T Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
    exists v. split; [exact Hv | apply val_type_irrel; exact Hvt].
  - (* sanitize Second, V Second *)
    destruct (Nat.leb tm i) eqn:E; [| discriminate].
    destruct (lc_index_inv vs2 ts2 C2 i T Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
    exists v. split.
    + rewrite EI. rewrite E. simpl. exact Hv.
    + apply val_type_irrel; exact Hvt.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The semantic statement for expressions                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition exp_type (k : nat) (venv : venv) (e : tm) (n : class) (T : ty) : Prop :=
  match teval k venv e n with
  | None => True
  | Some None => False
  | Some (Some v) => val_type venv v T
  end.

Lemma exp_type_fund : forall k venv tenv e n T,
  has_type tenv e n T -> wf_env venv tenv -> exp_type k venv e n T.
Proof.
  intros k. induction k as [|k' IH].
  - intros venv tenv e n T Hty Hwf. unfold exp_type. simpl. exact I.
  - intros venv tenv e n T Hty Hwf. unfold exp_type. simpl.
    destruct Hty as [n0 env0
                   | n0 env0
                   | n0 x env0 T1 Hlk
                   | m retcl q env0 f x T1 T2 Hf Hx Hsub
                   | m n0 retcl env0 y T1 T2 Hbody].
    + (* t_true *)
      simpl. constructor.
    + (* t_false *)
      simpl. constructor.
    + (* t_var *)
      simpl.
      destruct (lookup_wf venv tenv Hwf n0 x T1 Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
      rewrite Hv. simpl. exact Hvt.
    + (* t_app *)
      remember (teval k' venv f Second) as Ef eqn:HEf.
      assert (IHf := IH venv tenv f Second (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) Hf Hwf).
      assert (IHx := IH venv tenv x m T1 Hx Hwf).
      unfold exp_type in IHf, IHx.
      rewrite HEf in IHf.
      destruct Ef as [[vf|]|].
      * (* f times out *) simpl. exact I.
      * (* f returns error *) simpl in IHf. simpl. exact IHf.
      * (* f returns value *)
        simpl in IHf.
        destruct vf as [b| env2 m0 ey retcl0].
        -- (* vbool, impossible *) exfalso. inversion IHf.
        -- (* vabs *)
           inversion IHf as [| env0 venv0 tenv0 y0 T1' T2' m' retcl' Hwf2 Hbody2];
             subst.
           destruct q; destruct retcl.
           ++ (* q = First, retcl = First *) simpl.
              destruct (teval k' venv x m) as [[vx|]|].
              ** simpl. exact I.
              ** simpl in IHx. simpl. exact IHx.
              ** simpl in IHx.
                 (* build the extended environment *)
                 assert (HW1 :
                   wf_env
                     (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey First) Second)
                     (expand_env tenv0 (TFun T1 m T2 First) Second)).
                 { econstructor.
                   - apply v_abs with (tenv := tenv0);
                       [ exact Hwf2 | exact Hbody2 ].
                   - exact Hwf2.
                   - pose proof (wf_env_facts _ _ Hwf2) as F2.
                     destruct F2 as (_ & _ & EI2 & _ & _). simpl. exact EI2. }
                 assert (HW2 :
                   wf_env
                     (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey First) Second) vx m)
                     (expand_env (expand_env tenv0 (TFun T1 m T2 First) Second) T1 m)).
                 { econstructor.
                   - apply val_type_irrel. exact IHx.
                   - exact HW1.
                   - pose proof (wf_env_facts _ _ HW1) as F3.
                     destruct F3 as (_ & _ & EI3 & _ & _). simpl. exact EI3. }
                 assert (IHb := IH _ _ ey _ T2 Hbody2 HW2).
                 unfold exp_type in IHb.
                 destruct (teval k' (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey First) Second) vx m) ey First) as [[vb|]|].
                 ** simpl. exact I.
                 ** simpl in IHb. simpl. exact IHb.
                 ** simpl in IHb. simpl. apply val_type_irrel. exact IHb.
           ++ (* q = First, retcl = Second: contradiction *)
              exfalso. simpl in Hsub. discriminate Hsub.
           ++ (* q = Second, retcl = First *)
              simpl.
              destruct (teval k' venv x m) as [[vx|]|].
              ** simpl. exact I.
              ** simpl in IHx. simpl. exact IHx.
              ** simpl in IHx.
                 assert (HW1 :
                   wf_env
                     (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey First) Second)
                     (expand_env tenv0 (TFun T1 m T2 First) Second)).
                 { econstructor.
                   - apply v_abs with (tenv := tenv0);
                       [ exact Hwf2 | exact Hbody2 ].
                   - exact Hwf2.
                   - pose proof (wf_env_facts _ _ Hwf2) as F2.
                     destruct F2 as (_ & _ & EI2 & _ & _). simpl. exact EI2. }
                 assert (HW2 :
                   wf_env
                     (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey First) Second) vx m)
                     (expand_env (expand_env tenv0 (TFun T1 m T2 First) Second) T1 m)).
                 { econstructor.
                   - apply val_type_irrel. exact IHx.
                   - exact HW1.
                   - pose proof (wf_env_facts _ _ HW1) as F3.
                     destruct F3 as (_ & _ & EI3 & _ & _). simpl. exact EI3. }
                 assert (IHb := IH _ _ ey _ T2 Hbody2 HW2).
                 unfold exp_type in IHb.
                 destruct (teval k' (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey First) Second) vx m) ey First) as [[vb|]|].
                 ** simpl. exact I.
                 ** simpl in IHb. simpl. exact IHb.
                 ** simpl in IHb. simpl. apply val_type_irrel. exact IHb.
           ++ (* q = Second, retcl = Second *)
              simpl.
              destruct (teval k' venv x m) as [[vx|]|].
              ** simpl. exact I.
              ** simpl in IHx. simpl. exact IHx.
              ** simpl in IHx.
                 assert (HW1 :
                   wf_env
                     (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey Second) Second)
                     (expand_env tenv0 (TFun T1 m T2 Second) Second)).
                 { econstructor.
                   - apply v_abs with (tenv := tenv0);
                       [ exact Hwf2 | exact Hbody2 ].
                   - exact Hwf2.
                   - pose proof (wf_env_facts _ _ Hwf2) as F2.
                     destruct F2 as (_ & _ & EI2 & _ & _). simpl. exact EI2. }
                 assert (HW2 :
                   wf_env
                     (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey Second) Second) vx m)
                     (expand_env (expand_env tenv0 (TFun T1 m T2 Second) Second) T1 m)).
                 { econstructor.
                   - apply val_type_irrel. exact IHx.
                   - exact HW1.
                   - pose proof (wf_env_facts _ _ HW1) as F3.
                     destruct F3 as (_ & _ & EI3 & _ & _). simpl. exact EI3. }
                 assert (IHb := IH _ _ ey _ T2 Hbody2 HW2).
                 unfold exp_type in IHb.
                 destruct (teval k' (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey Second) Second) vx m) ey Second) as [[vb|]|].
                 ** simpl. exact I.
                 ** simpl in IHb. simpl. exact IHb.
                 ** simpl in IHb. simpl. apply val_type_irrel. exact IHb.
    + (* t_abs *)
      simpl.
      apply v_abs with (venv := sanitize_env n0 venv) (tenv := sanitize_env n0 tenv).
      * apply wf_env_sanitize_env. exact Hwf.
      * exact Hbody.
Qed.

Theorem full_safety : forall k e n tenv venv res T,
  teval k venv e n = Some res -> has_type tenv e n T -> wf_env venv tenv ->
  res_type venv res T.
Proof.
  intros k e n tenv venv res T Hevt Hty Hwf.
  pose proof (exp_type_fund k venv tenv e n T Hty Hwf) as H.
  unfold exp_type in H.
  rewrite Hevt in H.
  destruct res as [v|].
  - simpl in H. apply not_stuck. exact H.
  - simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Require Export Arith.EqNat.

From Stdlib Require Export PeanoNat.

Require Export stlc1.

Inductive wf_env : venv -> tenv -> Prop :=
| wfe_nil : forall n, wf_env (@Def vl nil nil n) (@Def ty nil nil n)
| wfe_cons : forall v t vs ts n,
    val_type (expand_env vs v n) v t ->
    wf_env vs ts ->
    get_inv_idx vs = get_inv_idx ts ->
    wf_env (expand_env vs v n) (expand_env ts t n)

with val_type : venv -> vl -> ty -> Prop :=
| v_bool: forall venv b,
    val_type venv (vbool b) TBool
| v_abs: forall env venv tenv y T1 T2 m retcl,
    wf_env venv tenv ->
    has_type (expand_env (expand_env tenv (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) Second) T1 m) y retcl T2 ->
    val_type env (vabs venv m y retcl) (TFun T1 m T2 retcl).

Inductive stp: venv -> ty -> venv -> ty -> Prop :=
| stp_refl: forall G1 G2 T,
   stp G1 T G2 T.

Inductive res_type: venv -> option vl -> ty -> Prop :=
| not_stuck: forall venv v T,
      val_type venv v T ->
      res_type venv (Some v) T.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Auxiliary machinery                                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Mutual induction principle for the wf_env / val_type block.  Coq does
   not generate the individual schemes automatically because the two
   types are defined mutually. *)
Scheme wf_env_mut_ind := Induction for wf_env Sort Prop
  with val_type_mut_ind := Induction for val_type Sort Prop.

(* Accessors for the two components of an environment. *)
Definition fc {X : Type} (e : @env X) : list X :=
  match e with Def l _ _ => l end.

Definition sc {X : Type} (e : @env X) : list X :=
  match e with Def _ l _ => l end.

Lemma fc_expand_first : forall {X} (e : @env X) x,
  fc (expand_env e x First) = x :: fc e.
Proof. intros X e x. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fc_expand_second : forall {X} (e : @env X) x,
  fc (expand_env e x Second) = fc e.
Proof. intros X e x. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sc_expand_first : forall {X} (e : @env X) x,
  sc (expand_env e x First) = sc e.
Proof. intros X e x. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sc_expand_second : forall {X} (e : @env X) x,
  sc (expand_env e x Second) = x :: sc e.
Proof. intros X e x. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. reflexivity. Qed.

(* val_type does not actually depend on its first (venv) argument. *)
Lemma val_type_irrel : forall a b v t, val_type a v t -> val_type b v t.
Proof.
  intros a b v t H. inversion H; subst.
  - constructor.
  - econstructor; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma sanitize_any_expand : forall {X} (e : @env X) x n k,
  sanitize_any (expand_env e x n) k = expand_env (sanitize_any e k) x n.
Proof.
  intros X e x n k. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. destruct n; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Changing the sc_min index simultaneously in both environments
   preserves well-formedness. *)
Lemma wf_env_sanitize_any : forall vs ts, wf_env vs ts ->
  forall k, wf_env (sanitize_any vs k) (sanitize_any ts k).
Proof.
  intros vs ts H.
  refine (wf_env_mut_ind
            (fun vs ts _ => forall k, wf_env (sanitize_any vs k) (sanitize_any ts k))
            (fun _ _ _ _ => True) _ _ _ _ vs ts H).
  - intros n k. simpl. constructor.
  - intros v t vs0 ts0 n Hv IHv Hw IHw He k.
    rewrite sanitize_any_expand. rewrite sanitize_any_expand.
    econstructor.
    + apply val_type_irrel. exact Hv.
    + apply IHw.
    + destruct (sanitize_any vs0 k) as [a b c];
      destruct (sanitize_any ts0 k) as [d e f]; reflexivity.
  - intros. exact I.
  - intros. exact I.
Qed.

(* Indexed structural description of a list of values paired with a list
   of types. *)
Fixpoint lc (vs : list vl) (ts : list ty) : Prop :=
  match vs, ts with
  | [], [] => True
  | v :: vs', t :: ts' => val_type (@Def vl [] [] 0) v t /\ lc vs' ts'
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Lemma lc_length : forall vs ts, lc vs ts -> length vs = length ts.
Proof.
  intros vs. induction vs as [|v vs' IH]; intros ts H.
  - destruct ts; simpl in *; [reflexivity | contradiction].
  - destruct ts as [|t ts']; simpl in *; [contradiction |].
    destruct H as [Hv Htl]. simpl. f_equal. apply IH, Htl.
Qed.

Lemma index_Some_lt : forall {X} (l : list X) i a,
  index i l = Some a -> i < length l.
Proof.
  intros X l. induction l as [|a l' IH]; intros i b Hi; simpl in Hi.
  - discriminate.
  - destruct (Nat.eqb i (length l')) eqn:E.
    + apply Nat.eqb_eq in E. lia.
    + apply IH in Hi. simpl. lia.
Qed.

Lemma index_exists : forall {X} (l : list X) i,
  i < length l -> exists a, index i l = Some a.
Proof.
  intros X l. induction l as [|a l' IH]; intros i Hi.
  - simpl in Hi. lia.
  - simpl. destruct (Nat.eqb i (length l')) eqn:E.
    + exists a. reflexivity.
    + apply IH. apply Nat.eqb_neq in E. simpl in Hi. lia.
Qed.

Lemma lc_index : forall vs ts, lc vs ts ->
  forall i v, index i vs = Some v ->
    exists t, index i ts = Some t /\ val_type (@Def vl [] [] 0) v t.
Proof.
  intros vs. induction vs as [|v' vs' IH]; intros ts Hlc i v Hi.
  - destruct ts; simpl in *; [discriminate | contradiction].
  - destruct ts as [|t' ts']; simpl in *; [contradiction |].
    destruct Hlc as [Hv Htl].
    destruct (Nat.eqb i (length vs')) eqn:E.
    + injection Hi as Hveq. subst v.
      assert (Hlen : length vs' = length ts') by (apply lc_length, Htl).
      assert (E' : (i =? length ts') = true)
        by (apply Nat.eqb_eq; apply Nat.eqb_eq in E; lia).
      exists t'. simpl. rewrite E'. split; [reflexivity | exact Hv].
    + eapply IH; [exact Htl | exact Hi].
Qed.

Lemma lc_index_inv : forall vs ts, lc vs ts ->
  forall i t, index i ts = Some t ->
    exists v, index i vs = Some v /\ val_type (@Def vl [] [] 0) v t.
Proof.
  intros vs ts Hlc i t Hi.
  assert (Hlen : length vs = length ts) by (apply lc_length, Hlc).
  assert (Hlt : i < length vs) by (rewrite Hlen; apply index_Some_lt, Hi).
  destruct (index_exists vs i Hlt) as [v Hv].
  destruct (lc_index vs ts Hlc i v Hv) as [t' [Ht' Hvt]].
  rewrite Hi in Ht'. injection Ht' as Heq. subst t'.
  exists v. split; [exact Hv | exact Hvt].
Qed.

(* Structural facts about well-formed environments. *)
Definition wf_facts (vs : venv) (ts : tenv) : Prop :=
  length (fc vs) = length (fc ts) /\
  length (sc vs) = length (sc ts) /\
  get_inv_idx vs = get_inv_idx ts /\
  lc (fc vs) (fc ts) /\
  lc (sc vs) (sc ts).

Lemma wf_env_facts : forall vs ts, wf_env vs ts -> wf_facts vs ts.
Proof.
  intros vs ts H.
  refine (wf_env_mut_ind
            (fun vs ts _ => wf_facts vs ts)
            (fun _ _ _ _ => True) _ _ _ _ vs ts H).
  - intros n. unfold wf_facts. simpl. repeat split; auto.
  - intros v t vs0 ts0 n Hv IHv Hw IHw He.
    unfold wf_facts in *.
    destruct IHw as (L1 & L2 & EI & C1 & C2).
    destruct vs0 as [vs1 vs2 vm]; destruct ts0 as [ts1 ts2 tm];
      destruct n; simpl in *.
    + repeat split.
      * simpl. f_equal. exact L1.
      * exact L2.
      * exact EI.
      * simpl. split; [ apply val_type_irrel; exact Hv | exact C1 ].
      * exact C2.
    + repeat split.
      * exact L1.
      * simpl. f_equal. exact L2.
      * exact EI.
      * exact C1.
      * simpl. split; [ apply val_type_irrel; exact Hv | exact C2 ].
  - intros. exact I.
  - intros. exact I.

(* Sanitizing by a class preserves well-formedness. *)
Lemma wf_env_sanitize_env : forall c venv tenv,
  wf_env venv tenv -> wf_env (sanitize_env c venv) (sanitize_env c tenv).
Proof.
  intros c venv tenv H. destruct c.
  - destruct venv as [vs1 vs2 vm]; destruct tenv as [ts1 ts2 tm].
    pose proof (wf_env_facts _ _ H) as F.
    destruct F as (L1 & L2 & EI & C1 & C2).
    simpl. rewrite <- L2.
    apply wf_env_sanitize_any. exact H.
  - exact H.
Qed.

(* Lookup correspondence between the two sides of a well-formed
   environment. *)
Lemma lookup_wf : forall venv tenv, wf_env venv tenv ->
  forall c x T, lookup x (sanitize_env c tenv) = Some T ->
    exists v, lookup x (sanitize_env c venv) = Some v /\ val_type venv v T.
Proof.
  intros venv tenv Hwf c x T Hlk.
  pose proof (wf_env_facts _ _ Hwf) as F.
  destruct F as (L1 & L2 & EI & C1 & C2).
  destruct venv as [vs1 vs2 vm]; destruct tenv as [ts1 ts2 tm].
  destruct x as [cl i]; destruct c; destruct cl; simpl in *.
  - (* sanitize First, V First *)
    destruct (lc_index_inv vs1 ts1 C1 i T Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
    exists v. split; [exact Hv | apply val_type_irrel; exact Hvt].
  - (* sanitize First, V Second *)
    destruct (Nat.leb (length ts2) i) eqn:E; [| discriminate].
    destruct (lc_index_inv vs2 ts2 C2 i T Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
    exists v. split.
    + rewrite L2. rewrite E. simpl. exact Hv.
    + apply val_type_irrel; exact Hvt.
  - (* sanitize Second, V First *)
    destruct (lc_index_inv vs1 ts1 C1 i T Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
    exists v. split; [exact Hv | apply val_type_irrel; exact Hvt].
  - (* sanitize Second, V Second *)
    destruct (Nat.leb tm i) eqn:E; [| discriminate].
    destruct (lc_index_inv vs2 ts2 C2 i T Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
    exists v. split.
    + rewrite EI. rewrite E. simpl. exact Hv.
    + apply val_type_irrel; exact Hvt.
Qed.

Theorem full_safety : forall k e n tenv venv res T,
  teval k venv e n = Some res -> has_type tenv e n T -> wf_env venv tenv ->
  res_type venv res T.
Proof.
  intros k e n tenv venv res T Hevt Hty Hwf.
  pose proof (exp_type_fund k venv tenv e n T Hty Hwf) as H.
  unfold exp_type in H.
  rewrite Hevt in H.
  destruct res as [v|].
  - simpl in H. apply not_stuck. exact H.
  - simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Require Export Arith.EqNat.

From Stdlib Require Export PeanoNat.

Require Export stlc1.

Inductive wf_env : venv -> tenv -> Prop :=
| wfe_nil : forall n, wf_env (@Def vl nil nil n) (@Def ty nil nil n)
| wfe_cons : forall v t vs ts n,
    val_type (expand_env vs v n) v t ->
    wf_env vs ts ->
    get_inv_idx vs = get_inv_idx ts ->
    wf_env (expand_env vs v n) (expand_env ts t n)

with val_type : venv -> vl -> ty -> Prop :=
| v_bool: forall venv b,
    val_type venv (vbool b) TBool
| v_abs: forall env venv tenv y T1 T2 m retcl,
    wf_env venv tenv ->
    has_type (expand_env (expand_env tenv (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) Second) T1 m) y retcl T2 ->
    val_type env (vabs venv m y retcl) (TFun T1 m T2 retcl).

Inductive stp: venv -> ty -> venv -> ty -> Prop :=
| stp_refl: forall G1 G2 T,
   stp G1 T G2 T.

Inductive res_type: venv -> option vl -> ty -> Prop :=
| not_stuck: forall venv v T,
      val_type venv v T ->
      res_type venv (Some v) T.

Theorem full_safety : forall k e n tenv venv res T,
  teval k venv e n = Some res -> has_type tenv e n T -> wf_env venv tenv ->
  res_type venv res T.

Require Export Arith.EqNat.

From Stdlib Require Export PeanoNat.

Require Export stlc1.

Inductive wf_env : venv -> tenv -> Prop :=
| wfe_nil : forall n, wf_env (@Def vl nil nil n) (@Def ty nil nil n)
| wfe_cons : forall v t vs ts n,
    val_type (expand_env vs v n) v t ->
    wf_env vs ts ->
    get_inv_idx vs = get_inv_idx ts ->
    wf_env (expand_env vs v n) (expand_env ts t n)

with val_type : venv -> vl -> ty -> Prop :=
| v_bool: forall venv b,
    val_type venv (vbool b) TBool
| v_abs: forall env venv tenv y T1 T2 m retcl,
    wf_env venv tenv ->
    has_type (expand_env (expand_env tenv (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) Second) T1 m) y retcl T2 ->
    val_type env (vabs venv m y retcl) (TFun T1 m T2 retcl).

Inductive stp: venv -> ty -> venv -> ty -> Prop :=
| stp_refl: forall G1 G2 T,
   stp G1 T G2 T.

Inductive res_type: venv -> option vl -> ty -> Prop :=
| not_stuck: forall venv v T,
      val_type venv v T ->
      res_type venv (Some v) T.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Auxiliary machinery                                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Mutual induction principle for the wf_env / val_type block.  Coq does
   not generate the individual schemes automatically because the two
   types are defined mutually. *)
Scheme wf_env_mut_ind := Induction for wf_env Sort Prop
  with val_type_mut_ind := Induction for val_type Sort Prop.

(* Accessors for the two components of an environment. *)
Definition fc {X : Type} (e : @env X) : list X :=
  match e with Def l _ _ => l end.

Definition sc {X : Type} (e : @env X) : list X :=
  match e with Def _ l _ => l end.

Lemma fc_expand_first : forall {X} (e : @env X) x,
  fc (expand_env e x First) = x :: fc e.
Proof. intros X e x. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fc_expand_second : forall {X} (e : @env X) x,
  fc (expand_env e x Second) = fc e.
Proof. intros X e x. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sc_expand_first : forall {X} (e : @env X) x,
  sc (expand_env e x First) = sc e.
Proof. intros X e x. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sc_expand_second : forall {X} (e : @env X) x,
  sc (expand_env e x Second) = x :: sc e.
Proof. intros X e x. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. reflexivity. Qed.

(* val_type does not actually depend on its first (venv) argument. *)
Lemma val_type_irrel : forall a b v t, val_type a v t -> val_type b v t.
Proof.
  intros a b v t H. inversion H; subst.
  - constructor.
  - econstructor; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inversion of a value of function type. *)
Lemma val_type_bool_inv : forall a b T, val_type a (vbool b) T -> T = TBool.
Proof. intros a b T H. inversion H. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma vabs_inv_gen : forall a venv m y retcl T1 m' T2 retcl',
  val_type a (vabs venv m y retcl) (TFun T1 m' T2 retcl') ->
  m = m' /\ retcl = retcl' /\
  exists tenv, wf_env venv tenv /\
    has_type (expand_env (expand_env tenv (TFun T1 m' T2 retcl') Second) T1 m')
             y retcl' T2.
Proof.
  intros a venv m y retcl T1 m' T2 retcl' H. inversion H. subst.
  split; [reflexivity | split; [reflexivity | eauto]].
Qed.

Lemma sanitize_any_expand : forall {X} (e : @env X) x n k,
  sanitize_any (expand_env e x n) k = expand_env (sanitize_any e k) x n.
Proof.
  intros X e x n k. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. destruct n; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Changing the sc_min index simultaneously in both environments
   preserves well-formedness. *)
Lemma wf_env_sanitize_any : forall vs ts, wf_env vs ts ->
  forall k, wf_env (sanitize_any vs k) (sanitize_any ts k).
Proof.
  intros vs ts H.
  refine (wf_env_mut_ind
            (fun vs ts _ => forall k, wf_env (sanitize_any vs k) (sanitize_any ts k))
            (fun _ _ _ _ => True) _ _ _ _ vs ts H).
  - intros n k. simpl. constructor.
  - intros v t vs0 ts0 n Hv IHv Hw IHw He k.
    rewrite sanitize_any_expand. rewrite sanitize_any_expand.
    econstructor.
    + apply val_type_irrel. exact Hv.
    + apply IHw.
    + destruct (sanitize_any vs0 k) as [a b c];
      destruct (sanitize_any ts0 k) as [d e f]; reflexivity.
  - intros. exact I.
  - intros. exact I.
Qed.

(* Indexed structural description of a list of values paired with a list
   of types. *)
Fixpoint lc (vs : list vl) (ts : list ty) : Prop :=
  match vs, ts with
  | [], [] => True
  | v :: vs', t :: ts' => val_type (@Def vl [] [] 0) v t /\ lc vs' ts'
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Lemma lc_length : forall vs ts, lc vs ts -> length vs = length ts.
Proof.
  intros vs. induction vs as [|v vs' IH]; intros ts H.
  - destruct ts; simpl in *; [reflexivity | contradiction].
  - destruct ts as [|t ts']; simpl in *; [contradiction |].
    destruct H as [Hv Htl]. simpl. f_equal. apply IH, Htl.
Qed.

Lemma index_Some_lt : forall {X} (l : list X) i a,
  index i l = Some a -> i < length l.
Proof.
  intros X l. induction l as [|a l' IH]; intros i b Hi; simpl in Hi.
  - discriminate.
  - destruct (Nat.eqb i (length l')) eqn:E.
    + apply Nat.eqb_eq in E. lia.
    + apply IH in Hi. simpl. lia.
Qed.

Lemma index_exists : forall {X} (l : list X) i,
  i < length l -> exists a, index i l = Some a.
Proof.
  intros X l. induction l as [|a l' IH]; intros i Hi.
  - simpl in Hi. lia.
  - simpl. destruct (Nat.eqb i (length l')) eqn:E.
    + exists a. reflexivity.
    + apply IH. apply Nat.eqb_neq in E. simpl in Hi. lia.
Qed.

Lemma lc_index : forall vs ts, lc vs ts ->
  forall i v, index i vs = Some v ->
    exists t, index i ts = Some t /\ val_type (@Def vl [] [] 0) v t.
Proof.
  intros vs. induction vs as [|v' vs' IH]; intros ts Hlc i v Hi.
  - destruct ts; simpl in *; [discriminate | contradiction].
  - destruct ts as [|t' ts']; simpl in *; [contradiction |].
    destruct Hlc as [Hv Htl].
    destruct (Nat.eqb i (length vs')) eqn:E.
    + injection Hi as Hveq. subst v.
      assert (Hlen : length vs' = length ts') by (apply lc_length, Htl).
      assert (E' : (i =? length ts') = true)
        by (apply Nat.eqb_eq; apply Nat.eqb_eq in E; lia).
      exists t'. simpl. rewrite E'. split; [reflexivity | exact Hv].
    + eapply IH; [exact Htl | exact Hi].
Qed.

Lemma lc_index_inv : forall vs ts, lc vs ts ->
  forall i t, index i ts = Some t ->
    exists v, index i vs = Some v /\ val_type (@Def vl [] [] 0) v t.
Proof.
  intros vs ts Hlc i t Hi.
  assert (Hlen : length vs = length ts) by (apply lc_length, Hlc).
  assert (Hlt : i < length vs) by (rewrite Hlen; apply index_Some_lt, Hi).
  destruct (index_exists vs i Hlt) as [v Hv].
  destruct (lc_index vs ts Hlc i v Hv) as [t' [Ht' Hvt]].
  rewrite Hi in Ht'. injection Ht' as Heq. subst t'.
  exists v. split; [exact Hv | exact Hvt].
Qed.

(* Structural facts about well-formed environments. *)
Definition wf_facts (vs : venv) (ts : tenv) : Prop :=
  length (fc vs) = length (fc ts) /\
  length (sc vs) = length (sc ts) /\
  get_inv_idx vs = get_inv_idx ts /\
  lc (fc vs) (fc ts) /\
  lc (sc vs) (sc ts).

Lemma wf_env_facts : forall vs ts, wf_env vs ts -> wf_facts vs ts.
Proof.
  intros vs ts H.
  refine (wf_env_mut_ind
            (fun vs ts _ => wf_facts vs ts)
            (fun _ _ _ _ => True) _ _ _ _ vs ts H).
  - intros n. unfold wf_facts. simpl. repeat split; auto.
  - intros v t vs0 ts0 n Hv IHv Hw IHw He.
    unfold wf_facts in *.
    destruct IHw as (L1 & L2 & EI & C1 & C2).
    destruct vs0 as [vs1 vs2 vm]; destruct ts0 as [ts1 ts2 tm];
      destruct n; simpl in *.
    + repeat split.
      * simpl. f_equal. exact L1.
      * exact L2.
      * exact EI.
      * simpl. split; [ apply val_type_irrel; exact Hv | exact C1 ].
      * exact C2.
    + repeat split.
      * exact L1.
      * simpl. f_equal. exact L2.
      * exact EI.
      * exact C1.
      * simpl. split; [ apply val_type_irrel; exact Hv | exact C2 ].
  - intros. exact I.
  - intros. exact I.
Qed.

(* Sanitizing by a class preserves well-formedness. *)
Lemma wf_env_sanitize_env : forall c venv tenv,
  wf_env venv tenv -> wf_env (sanitize_env c venv) (sanitize_env c tenv).
Proof.
  intros c venv tenv H. destruct c.
  - destruct venv as [vs1 vs2 vm]; destruct tenv as [ts1 ts2 tm].
    pose proof (wf_env_facts _ _ H) as F.
    destruct F as (L1 & L2 & EI & C1 & C2).
    simpl. rewrite <- L2.
    apply wf_env_sanitize_any. exact H.
  - exact H.
Qed.

(* Lookup correspondence between the two sides of a well-formed
   environment. *)
Lemma lookup_wf : forall venv tenv, wf_env venv tenv ->
  forall c x T, lookup x (sanitize_env c tenv) = Some T ->
    exists v, lookup x (sanitize_env c venv) = Some v /\ val_type venv v T.
Proof.
  intros venv tenv Hwf c x T Hlk.
  pose proof (wf_env_facts _ _ Hwf) as F.
  destruct F as (L1 & L2 & EI & C1 & C2).
  destruct venv as [vs1 vs2 vm]; destruct tenv as [ts1 ts2 tm].
  destruct x as [cl i]; destruct c; destruct cl; simpl in *.
  - (* sanitize First, V First *)
    destruct (lc_index_inv vs1 ts1 C1 i T Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
    exists v. split; [exact Hv | apply val_type_irrel; exact Hvt].
  - (* sanitize First, V Second *)
    destruct (Nat.leb (length ts2) i) eqn:E; [| discriminate].
    destruct (lc_index_inv vs2 ts2 C2 i T Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
    exists v. split.
    + rewrite L2. rewrite E. simpl. exact Hv.
    + apply val_type_irrel; exact Hvt.
  - (* sanitize Second, V First *)
    destruct (lc_index_inv vs1 ts1 C1 i T Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
    exists v. split; [exact Hv | apply val_type_irrel; exact Hvt].
  - (* sanitize Second, V Second *)
    destruct (Nat.leb tm i) eqn:E; [| discriminate].
    destruct (lc_index_inv vs2 ts2 C2 i T Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
    exists v. split.
    + rewrite EI. rewrite E. simpl. exact Hv.
    + apply val_type_irrel; exact Hvt.
Qed.

(* Extending a well-formed environment with a value of the argument type
   (and with the closure itself as a second-class member) stays
   well-formed. *)
Lemma wf_env_extend : forall (env2 : venv) (tenv0 : tenv) (vx : vl)
                             (T1 : ty) (m : class) (ey : tm) (retcl : class) (T2 : ty),
  wf_env env2 tenv0 ->
  has_type (expand_env (expand_env tenv0 (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) Second) T1 m)
           ey retcl T2 ->
  val_type env2 vx T1 ->
  wf_env (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey retcl) Second) vx m)
         (expand_env (expand_env tenv0 (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) Second) T1 m).
Proof.
  intros env2 tenv0 vx T1 m ey retcl T2 Hwf0 Hbody Hvx.
  pose proof (wf_env_facts _ _ Hwf0) as F.
  destruct F as (_ & _ & EI & _ & _).
  econstructor.
  - apply val_type_irrel. exact Hvx.
  - econstructor.
    + apply v_abs with (tenv := tenv0); [ exact Hwf0 | exact Hbody ].
    + exact Hwf0.
    + simpl. exact EI.
  - simpl. exact EI.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The semantic statement for expressions                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition exp_type (k : nat) (venv : venv) (e : tm) (n : class) (T : ty) : Prop :=
  match teval k venv e n with
  | None => True
  | Some None => False
  | Some (Some v) => val_type venv v T
  end.

(* The continuation of an application once the function evaluated to a
   closure whose return class is C. *)
Ltac solve_cont C :=
  simpl;
  destruct (teval k' venv x m) as [[vx|]|];
  [ simpl; exact I
  | simpl in IHx; simpl; exact IHx
  | simpl in IHx;
    assert (Hw : wf_env
      (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey C) Second) vx m)
      (expand_env (expand_env tenv0 (TFun T1 m T2 C) Second) T1 m))
      by (apply wf_env_extend;
          [ exact Hwf2 | exact Hbody2 | apply val_type_irrel; exact IHx ]);
    assert (IHc : exp_type k'
      (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey C) Second) vx m) ey C T2)
      by (apply (IH (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey C) Second) vx m)
                    (expand_env (expand_env tenv0 (TFun T1 m T2 C) Second) T1 m)
                    ey C T2 Hbody2 Hw));
    unfold exp_type in IHc;
    destruct (teval k'
      (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey C) Second) vx m) ey C)
      as [[vb|]|];
    [ simpl; exact I
    | simpl in IHc; simpl; exact IHc
    | simpl in IHc; simpl; apply val_type_irrel; exact IHc ] ].

Lemma exp_type_fund : forall k venv tenv e n T,
  has_type tenv e n T -> wf_env venv tenv -> exp_type k venv e n T.
Proof.
  intros k. induction k as [|k' IH].
  - intros venv tenv e n T Hty Hwf. unfold exp_type. simpl. exact I.
  - intros venv tenv e n T Hty Hwf. unfold exp_type. simpl.
    destruct Hty as [n0 env0
                   | n0 env0
                   | n0 x env0 T1 Hlk
                   | m retcl q env0 f x T1 T2 Hf Hx Hsub
                   | m n0 retcl env0 y T1 T2 Hbody].
    + (* t_true *)
      simpl. constructor.
    + (* t_false *)
      simpl. constructor.
    + (* t_var *)
      simpl.
      destruct (lookup_wf venv tenv Hwf n0 x T1 Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
      rewrite Hv. simpl. exact Hvt.
    + (* t_app *)
      remember (teval k' venv f Second) as Ef eqn:HEf.
      assert (IHf := IH venv tenv f Second (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) Hf Hwf).
      assert (IHx := IH venv tenv x m T1 Hx Hwf).
      unfold exp_type in IHf, IHx.
      rewrite HEf in IHf.
      destruct Ef as [[vf|]|].
      * (* f times out *) simpl. exact I.
      * (* f returns an error *) simpl in IHf. simpl. exact IHf.
      * (* f returns a value *)
        simpl in IHf.
        destruct vf as [b | env2 m0 ey retcl0].
        -- (* a boolean cannot have a function type *)
           simpl. pose proof (val_type_bool_inv _ _ _ IHf) as E. discriminate E.
        -- (* a closure *)
           destruct (vabs_inv_gen _ env2 _ ey _ _ _ _ _ IHf)
             as [Hm [Hr Hx0]].
           destruct Hx0 as [tenv0 [Hwf2 Hbody2]].
           subst m0. subst retcl0.
           destruct retcl; destruct q.
           ++ solve_cont First.
           ++ solve_cont First.
           ++ (* return class Second at class First: rejected *)
              exfalso. simpl in Hsub. discriminate Hsub.
           ++ solve_cont Second.
    + (* t_abs *)
      simpl.
      apply v_abs with (venv := sanitize_env n0 venv) (tenv := sanitize_env n0 tenv).
      * apply wf_env_sanitize_env. exact Hwf.
      * exact Hbody.
Qed.

Theorem full_safety : forall k e n tenv venv res T,
  teval k venv e n = Some res -> has_type tenv e n T -> wf_env venv tenv ->
  res_type venv res T.
Proof.
  intros k e n tenv venv res T Hevt Hty Hwf.
  pose proof (exp_type_fund k venv tenv e n T Hty Hwf) as H.
  unfold exp_type in H.
  rewrite Hevt in H.
  destruct res as [v|].
  - simpl in H. apply not_stuck. exact H.
  - simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Require Export Arith.EqNat.

From Stdlib Require Export PeanoNat.

Require Export stlc1.

Inductive wf_env : venv -> tenv -> Prop :=
| wfe_nil : forall n, wf_env (@Def vl nil nil n) (@Def ty nil nil n)
| wfe_cons : forall v t vs ts n,
    val_type (expand_env vs v n) v t ->
    wf_env vs ts ->
    get_inv_idx vs = get_inv_idx ts ->
    wf_env (expand_env vs v n) (expand_env ts t n)

with val_type : venv -> vl -> ty -> Prop :=
| v_bool: forall venv b,
    val_type venv (vbool b) TBool
| v_abs: forall env venv tenv y T1 T2 m retcl,
    wf_env venv tenv ->
    has_type (expand_env (expand_env tenv (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) Second) T1 m) y retcl T2 ->
    val_type env (vabs venv m y retcl) (TFun T1 m T2 retcl).

Inductive stp: venv -> ty -> venv -> ty -> Prop :=
| stp_refl: forall G1 G2 T,
   stp G1 T G2 T.

Inductive res_type: venv -> option vl -> ty -> Prop :=
| not_stuck: forall venv v T,
      val_type venv v T ->
      res_type venv (Some v) T.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Auxiliary machinery                                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Mutual induction principle for the wf_env / val_type block.  Coq does
   not generate the individual schemes automatically because the two
   types are defined mutually. *)
Scheme wf_env_mut_ind := Induction for wf_env Sort Prop
  with val_type_mut_ind := Induction for val_type Sort Prop.

(* Accessors for the two components of an environment. *)
Definition fc {X : Type} (e : @env X) : list X :=
  match e with Def l _ _ => l end.

Definition sc {X : Type} (e : @env X) : list X :=
  match e with Def _ l _ => l end.

Lemma fc_expand_first : forall {X} (e : @env X) x,
  fc (expand_env e x First) = x :: fc e.
Proof. intros X e x. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fc_expand_second : forall {X} (e : @env X) x,
  fc (expand_env e x Second) = fc e.
Proof. intros X e x. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sc_expand_first : forall {X} (e : @env X) x,
  sc (expand_env e x First) = sc e.
Proof. intros X e x. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sc_expand_second : forall {X} (e : @env X) x,
  sc (expand_env e x Second) = x :: sc e.
Proof. intros X e x. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. reflexivity. Qed.

(* val_type does not actually depend on its first (venv) argument. *)
Lemma val_type_irrel : forall a b v t, val_type a v t -> val_type b v t.
Proof.
  intros a b v t H. inversion H; subst.
  - constructor.
  - econstructor; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inversion of a value of function type. *)
Lemma val_type_bool_inv : forall a b T, val_type a (vbool b) T -> T = TBool.
Proof. intros a b T H. inversion H. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma vabs_inv_gen : forall a venv m y retcl T1 m' T2 retcl',
  val_type a (vabs venv m y retcl) (TFun T1 m' T2 retcl') ->
  m = m' /\ retcl = retcl' /\
  exists tenv, wf_env venv tenv /\
    has_type (expand_env (expand_env tenv (TFun T1 m' T2 retcl') Second) T1 m')
             y retcl' T2.
Proof.
  intros a venv m y retcl T1 m' T2 retcl' H. inversion H. subst.
  split; [reflexivity | split; [reflexivity | eauto]].
Qed.

Lemma sanitize_any_expand : forall {X} (e : @env X) x n k,
  sanitize_any (expand_env e x n) k = expand_env (sanitize_any e k) x n.
Proof.
  intros X e x n k. destruct e as [l1 l2 m]. destruct n; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Changing the sc_min index simultaneously in both environments
   preserves well-formedness. *)
Lemma wf_env_sanitize_any : forall vs ts, wf_env vs ts ->
  forall k, wf_env (sanitize_any vs k) (sanitize_any ts k).
Proof.
  intros vs ts H.
  refine (wf_env_mut_ind
            (fun vs ts _ => forall k, wf_env (sanitize_any vs k) (sanitize_any ts k))
            (fun _ _ _ _ => True) _ _ _ _ vs ts H).
  - intros n k. simpl. constructor.
  - intros v t vs0 ts0 n Hv IHv Hw IHw He k.
    rewrite sanitize_any_expand. rewrite sanitize_any_expand.
    econstructor.
    + apply val_type_irrel. exact Hv.
    + apply IHw.
    + destruct (sanitize_any vs0 k) as [a b c];
      destruct (sanitize_any ts0 k) as [d e f]; reflexivity.
  - intros. exact I.
  - intros. exact I.
Qed.

(* Indexed structural description of a list of values paired with a list
   of types. *)
Fixpoint lc (vs : list vl) (ts : list ty) : Prop :=
  match vs, ts with
  | [], [] => True
  | v :: vs', t :: ts' => val_type (@Def vl [] [] 0) v t /\ lc vs' ts'
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Lemma lc_length : forall vs ts, lc vs ts -> length vs = length ts.
Proof.
  intros vs. induction vs as [|v vs' IH]; intros ts H.
  - destruct ts; simpl in *; [reflexivity | contradiction].
  - destruct ts as [|t ts']; simpl in *; [contradiction |].
    destruct H as [Hv Htl]. simpl. f_equal. apply IH, Htl.
Qed.

Lemma index_Some_lt : forall {X} (l : list X) i a,
  index i l = Some a -> i < length l.
Proof.
  intros X l. induction l as [|a l' IH]; intros i b Hi; simpl in Hi.
  - discriminate.
  - destruct (Nat.eqb i (length l')) eqn:E.
    + apply Nat.eqb_eq in E. lia.
    + apply IH in Hi. simpl. lia.
Qed.

Lemma index_exists : forall {X} (l : list X) i,
  i < length l -> exists a, index i l = Some a.
Proof.
  intros X l. induction l as [|a l' IH]; intros i Hi.
  - simpl in Hi. lia.
  - simpl. destruct (Nat.eqb i (length l')) eqn:E.
    + exists a. reflexivity.
    + apply IH. apply Nat.eqb_neq in E. simpl in Hi. lia.
Qed.

Lemma lc_index : forall vs ts, lc vs ts ->
  forall i v, index i vs = Some v ->
    exists t, index i ts = Some t /\ val_type (@Def vl [] [] 0) v t.
Proof.
  intros vs. induction vs as [|v' vs' IH]; intros ts Hlc i v Hi.
  - destruct ts; simpl in *; [discriminate | contradiction].
  - destruct ts as [|t' ts']; simpl in *; [contradiction |].
    destruct Hlc as [Hv Htl].
    destruct (Nat.eqb i (length vs')) eqn:E.
    + injection Hi as Hveq. subst v.
      assert (Hlen : length vs' = length ts') by (apply lc_length, Htl).
      assert (E' : (i =? length ts') = true)
        by (apply Nat.eqb_eq; apply Nat.eqb_eq in E; lia).
      exists t'. simpl. rewrite E'. split; [reflexivity | exact Hv].
    + eapply IH; [exact Htl | exact Hi].
Qed.

Lemma lc_index_inv : forall vs ts, lc vs ts ->
  forall i t, index i ts = Some t ->
    exists v, index i vs = Some v /\ val_type (@Def vl [] [] 0) v t.
Proof.
  intros vs ts Hlc i t Hi.
  assert (Hlen : length vs = length ts) by (apply lc_length, Hlc).
  assert (Hlt : i < length vs) by (rewrite Hlen; apply index_Some_lt, Hi).
  destruct (index_exists vs i Hlt) as [v Hv].
  destruct (lc_index vs ts Hlc i v Hv) as [t' [Ht' Hvt]].
  rewrite Hi in Ht'. injection Ht' as Heq. subst t'.
  exists v. split; [exact Hv | exact Hvt].
Qed.

(* Structural facts about well-formed environments. *)
Definition wf_facts (vs : venv) (ts : tenv) : Prop :=
  length (fc vs) = length (fc ts) /\
  length (sc vs) = length (sc ts) /\
  get_inv_idx vs = get_inv_idx ts /\
  lc (fc vs) (fc ts) /\
  lc (sc vs) (sc ts).

Lemma wf_env_facts : forall vs ts, wf_env vs ts -> wf_facts vs ts.
Proof.
  intros vs ts H.
  refine (wf_env_mut_ind
            (fun vs ts _ => wf_facts vs ts)
            (fun _ _ _ _ => True) _ _ _ _ vs ts H).
  - intros n. unfold wf_facts. simpl. repeat split; auto.
  - intros v t vs0 ts0 n Hv IHv Hw IHw He.
    unfold wf_facts in *.
    destruct IHw as (L1 & L2 & EI & C1 & C2).
    destruct vs0 as [vs1 vs2 vm]; destruct ts0 as [ts1 ts2 tm];
      destruct n; simpl in *.
    + repeat split.
      * simpl. f_equal. exact L1.
      * exact L2.
      * exact EI.
      * simpl. split; [ apply val_type_irrel; exact Hv | exact C1 ].
      * exact C2.
    + repeat split.
      * exact L1.
      * simpl. f_equal. exact L2.
      * exact EI.
      * exact C1.
      * simpl. split; [ apply val_type_irrel; exact Hv | exact C2 ].
  - intros. exact I.
  - intros. exact I.
Qed.

(* Sanitizing by a class preserves well-formedness. *)
Lemma wf_env_sanitize_env : forall c venv tenv,
  wf_env venv tenv -> wf_env (sanitize_env c venv) (sanitize_env c tenv).
Proof.
  intros c venv tenv H. destruct c.
  - destruct venv as [vs1 vs2 vm]; destruct tenv as [ts1 ts2 tm].
    pose proof (wf_env_facts _ _ H) as F.
    destruct F as (L1 & L2 & EI & C1 & C2).
    simpl. rewrite <- L2.
    apply wf_env_sanitize_any. exact H.
  - exact H.
Qed.

(* Lookup correspondence between the two sides of a well-formed
   environment. *)
Lemma lookup_wf : forall venv tenv, wf_env venv tenv ->
  forall c x T, lookup x (sanitize_env c tenv) = Some T ->
    exists v, lookup x (sanitize_env c venv) = Some v /\ val_type venv v T.
Proof.
  intros venv tenv Hwf c x T Hlk.
  pose proof (wf_env_facts _ _ Hwf) as F.
  destruct F as (L1 & L2 & EI & C1 & C2).
  destruct venv as [vs1 vs2 vm]; destruct tenv as [ts1 ts2 tm].
  destruct x as [cl i]; destruct c; destruct cl; simpl in *.
  - (* sanitize First, V First *)
    destruct (lc_index_inv vs1 ts1 C1 i T Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
    exists v. split; [exact Hv | apply val_type_irrel; exact Hvt].
  - (* sanitize First, V Second *)
    destruct (Nat.leb (length ts2) i) eqn:E; [| discriminate].
    destruct (lc_index_inv vs2 ts2 C2 i T Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
    exists v. split.
    + rewrite L2. rewrite E. simpl. exact Hv.
    + apply val_type_irrel; exact Hvt.
  - (* sanitize Second, V First *)
    destruct (lc_index_inv vs1 ts1 C1 i T Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
    exists v. split; [exact Hv | apply val_type_irrel; exact Hvt].
  - (* sanitize Second, V Second *)
    destruct (Nat.leb tm i) eqn:E; [| discriminate].
    destruct (lc_index_inv vs2 ts2 C2 i T Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
    exists v. split.
    + rewrite EI. rewrite E. simpl. exact Hv.
    + apply val_type_irrel; exact Hvt.
Qed.

(* Extending a well-formed environment with a value of the argument type
   (and with the closure itself as a second-class member) stays
   well-formed. *)
Lemma wf_env_extend : forall (env2 : venv) (tenv0 : tenv) (vx : vl)
                             (T1 : ty) (m : class) (ey : tm) (retcl : class) (T2 : ty),
  wf_env env2 tenv0 ->
  has_type (expand_env (expand_env tenv0 (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) Second) T1 m)
           ey retcl T2 ->
  val_type env2 vx T1 ->
  wf_env (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey retcl) Second) vx m)
         (expand_env (expand_env tenv0 (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) Second) T1 m).
Proof.
  intros env2 tenv0 vx T1 m ey retcl T2 Hwf0 Hbody Hvx.
  pose proof (wf_env_facts _ _ Hwf0) as F.
  destruct F as (_ & _ & EI & _ & _).
  econstructor.
  - apply val_type_irrel. exact Hvx.
  - econstructor.
    + apply v_abs with (tenv := tenv0); [ exact Hwf0 | exact Hbody ].
    + exact Hwf0.
    + simpl. exact EI.
  - simpl. exact EI.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The semantic statement for expressions                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition exp_type (k : nat) (venv : venv) (e : tm) (n : class) (T : ty) : Prop :=
  match teval k venv e n with
  | None => True
  | Some None => False
  | Some (Some v) => val_type venv v T
  end.

(* The continuation of an application once the function evaluated to a
   closure whose return class is C. *)
Ltac solve_cont C :=
  simpl;
  destruct (teval k' venv x m) as [[vx|]|];
  [ simpl; exact I
  | simpl in IHx; simpl; exact IHx
  | simpl in IHx;
    assert (Hw : wf_env
      (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey C) Second) vx m)
      (expand_env (expand_env tenv0 (TFun T1 m T2 C) Second) T1 m))
      by (apply wf_env_extend;
          [ exact Hwf2 | exact Hbody2 | apply val_type_irrel; exact IHx ]);
    assert (IHc : exp_type k'
      (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey C) Second) vx m) ey C T2)
      by (apply (IH (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey C) Second) vx m)
                    (expand_env (expand_env tenv0 (TFun T1 m T2 C) Second) T1 m)
                    ey C T2 Hbody2 Hw));
    unfold exp_type in IHc;
    destruct (teval k'
      (expand_env (expand_env env2 (vabs env2 m ey C) Second) vx m) ey C)
      as [[vb|]|];
    [ simpl; exact I
    | simpl in IHc; simpl; exact IHc
    | simpl in IHc; simpl; apply val_type_irrel; exact IHc ] ].

Lemma exp_type_fund : forall k venv tenv e n T,
  has_type tenv e n T -> wf_env venv tenv -> exp_type k venv e n T.
Proof.
  intros k. induction k as [|k' IH].
  - intros venv tenv e n T Hty Hwf. unfold exp_type. simpl. exact I.
  - intros venv tenv e n T Hty Hwf. unfold exp_type. simpl.
    destruct Hty as [n0 env0
                   | n0 env0
                   | n0 x env0 T1 Hlk
                   | m retcl q env0 f x T1 T2 Hf Hx Hsub
                   | m n0 retcl env0 y T1 T2 Hbody].
    + (* t_true *)
      simpl. constructor.
    + (* t_false *)
      simpl. constructor.
    + (* t_var *)
      simpl.
      destruct (lookup_wf venv tenv Hwf n0 x T1 Hlk) as [v [Hv Hvt]].
      rewrite Hv. simpl. exact Hvt.
    + (* t_app *)
      remember (teval k' venv f Second) as Ef eqn:HEf.
      assert (IHf := IH venv tenv f Second (TFun T1 m T2 retcl) Hf Hwf).
      assert (IHx := IH venv tenv x m T1 Hx Hwf).
      unfold exp_type in IHf, IHx.
      rewrite HEf in IHf.
      destruct Ef as [[vf|]|].
      * (* f times out *) simpl. exact I.
      * (* f returns an error *) simpl in IHf. simpl. exact IHf.
      * (* f returns a value *)
        simpl in IHf.
        destruct vf as [b | env2 m0 ey retcl0].
        -- (* a boolean cannot have a function type *)
           simpl. pose proof (val_type_bool_inv _ _ _ IHf) as E. discriminate E.
        -- (* a closure *)
           destruct (vabs_inv_gen _ env2 _ ey _ _ _ _ _ IHf)
             as [Hm [Hr Hx0]].
           destruct Hx0 as [tenv0 [Hwf2 Hbody2]].
           subst m0. subst retcl0.
           destruct retcl; destruct q.
           ++ solve_cont First.
           ++ solve_cont First.
           ++ (* return class Second at class First: rejected *)
              exfalso. simpl in Hsub. discriminate Hsub.
           ++ solve_cont Second.
    + (* t_abs *)
      simpl.
      apply v_abs with (venv := sanitize_env n0 venv) (tenv := sanitize_env n0 tenv).
      * apply wf_env_sanitize_env. exact Hwf.
      * exact Hbody.
Qed.

Theorem full_safety : forall k e n tenv venv res T,
  teval k venv e n = Some res -> has_type tenv e n T -> wf_env venv tenv ->
  res_type venv res T.
Proof.
  intros k e n tenv venv res T Hevt Hty Hwf.
  pose proof (exp_type_fund k venv tenv e n T Hty Hwf) as H.
  unfold exp_type in H.
  rewrite Hevt in H.
  destruct res as [v|].
  - simpl in H. apply not_stuck. exact H.
  - simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.
